card.name: The word our before shared-world nouns
card.fires_on: The word "our" (also sentence-initial "Our") in general web text, especially after a verb or preposition and before a shared-world noun like universe, planet, galaxy, or natural resources.

modes.label: Our + cosmos/planet
modes.description: "our" before universe, planet, or Milky Way in science text.
modes.example: Scientists seem convinced that such a tiny singularity (black hole) would pass right through<< our>> planet without gobbling enough mass to slow

modes.label: Our + community/resources
modes.description: "our" before resources, members, or abilities in advocacy or organization text.
modes.example: Recycle at school and home to reduce waste, save energy & protect<< our>> natural resources.

card.writes: It suppresses "our" and its translations, so the pole's negative side marks places where "our" is already being said.
card.plain: It fires on the word "our" when a writer speaks of we-all things like our universe, planet, or resources.
